title: The build the beta opened on
summary: Put online the day before the beta opened, with many changes from the BlizzCon demo: spellbooks go to level 60 with every rank, and several talent trees changed shape.
sourceNote: No official Blizzard post is linked for this build. The talent changes below come from our own record of the September 18 data sync against the BlizzCon demo, not from patch notes.

warlock.name: Wrack
warlock.text: New talent, taking the slot where Drain Hope used to be.

rogue.name: Flawless Execution
rogue.text: New talent, taking the slot where Restless Blades used to be.

warrior.name: Vitality
warrior.text: Gone from the Protection tree; Bastion and Focused Rage each moved into a vacated slot.
